title: Acknowledgments
text: ACKNOWLEDGMENTS In writing this book, I owe a deep debt to the scientists, researchers, philosophers, and technologists whose work illuminates every page. Their discoveries in neuroscience and artificial intelligence have given us the foundation to ask deeper questions about how intelligence emerges, both biological and artificial. I am grateful for their dedication to understanding these complex topics and their generosity in sharing what they have found with the world. And finally, to Ray Kurzweil, whose book The Singularity Is Near lit a fire of curiosity in my mind many years ago, and who continues to inspire me from afar. What follows is a seeking of perspective from elements of their work—a consilience of sorts, linking discoveries that are often studied in isolation. Any meaningful foundational insights here come from them; any errors are my own. OceanofPDF.com
